changelog:
### 🚀 WA RuntimeKit v3.0 Major Overhaul
- **APK Size Reduced by 52%:** Shrunk from 71.5 MB to 33.9 MB with single arm64-v8a architecture & R8 tree-shaking.
- **Dead Features Purged:** Removed legacy custom CSS engine, floating bar, separate groups, IG status & old tasker hooks.
- **100% Resource Safety:** All UI strings & drawables unified through moduleContext to permanently eliminate Resources.NotFoundException.
- **SeenTick 120 FPS Optimization:** Pre-cached Drawable.ConstantState wrappers with zero bitmap copying on UI thread.
- **View-Once Auto-Saver:** Automatically saves view-once media to Download/WhatsApp/ViewOnce/.
- **FLAG_SECURE Remover:** Bypass screenshot & screen recording blocks on view-once media and secret chats.
- **Force External Browser:** Seamlessly open links in your default system browser.
- **Chat Forensics / Message Counter:** Real-time SQLite statistics & message breakdown per contact.
- **Status Anti-Delete Auto-Archiver:** Automatically preserves deleted contact statuses to local storage.
